q1: SELECT DISTINCT AUTHOR_ID AS ID FROM VIEWS WHERE AUTHOR_ID = VIEWER_ID ORDER BY ID
q2: SELECT T.AUTHOR_ID AS ID FROM (SELECT AUTHOR_ID FROM VIEWS WHERE AUTHOR_ID = VIEWER_ID GROUP BY AUTHOR_ID HAVING COUNT(AUTHOR_ID) >=1) T ORDER BY T.AUTHOR_ID
